features.description: Engineered with smart automation and precision technology for reliable, efficient, and high-performance textile printing

items.title: 8 Epson i3200-A1 Printheads
items.desc: Eight industrial Epson i3200-A1 heads deliver crisp, high-resolution output at up to 1200 x 2400 dpi for sharp foil adhesive placement and vibrant sublimation printing on fabric and paper.

items.title: Maglev Linear Motor System
items.desc: Magnetic levitation linear motor drives the carriage with ultra-smooth, vibration-free movement, ensuring consistent ink placement accuracy for precise foil and sublimation registration across every print.

items.title: Dual Dryer System
items.desc: Two integrated drying zones ensure rapid ink setting and vibrant colour retention on foil media, reducing transfer errors and delivering consistent adhesive activation across different fabric weights.

items.title: 6-Zone Cooling System
items.desc: Built-in zoned temperature control across the print area maintains stable printhead operating conditions and ensures precise foil transfer without thermal distortion or adhesive inconsistencies.

items.title: White Ink Circulation and Ink Shortage Alarm
items.desc: Continuous white ink circulation prevents pigment settling in channels during idle periods, while real-time ink shortage alerts notify operators before production is interrupted.

items.title: Anti-Collision Carriage Protection
items.desc: Sensor-based carriage protection detects obstacles in the print path and immediately stops movement to prevent printhead contact damage during fabric or media loading.

items.title: Fully Automated Ink Supply System
items.desc: Automated bulk ink delivery to all 8 heads maintains consistent ink pressure and reduces manual refill frequency, supporting longer uninterrupted production runs with minimal operator intervention.

items.title: Mesh Belt Conveying System
items.desc: Open-mesh belt transport allows airflow through the media during drying while maintaining stable fabric positioning throughout the foil adhesive printing and collection process.

items.title: High Production Output
items.desc: Designed for industrial production environments with a capacity of up to 2,200 linear metres per day, making it suitable for large-volume operations.

items.title: Epson I3200 Printhead Technology
items.desc: Features 8 industrial Epson I3200-A1 printheads known for high precision printing, consistent colour reproduction, long production runs, and stable performance at high speeds.

items.title: Industrial Roll-to-Roll Design
items.desc: Continuous production workflow, stable media transport, suitable for long production runs, optimized for transfer paper printing.

items.title: Sublimation Printing Applications
items.desc: Ideal for sportswear, activewear, fashion fabrics, home textiles, curtains, cushion covers, promotional textiles, and soft signage graphics.

idealFor.description: Perfectly suited for a wide range of textile applications, delivering exceptional print quality, color vibrancy, and production efficiency across diverse fabric categories.

fabrics.title: Fashion Fabric Foil Printing
fabrics.desc: Precise digital foil adhesive printing on sarees, dress materials, kurtis, and fashion fabrics for wholesale and export manufacturers adding metallic, holographic, or glitter foil effects to textile designs.

fabrics.title: Ethnic and Bridal Wear Embellishment
fabrics.desc: High-resolution foil placement on lehenga, dupatta, sherwani, and bridal fabric for designers and manufacturers producing premium ethnic and occasion wear with intricate foil pattern detailing.

fabrics.title: Sportswear and Activewear Sublimation
fabrics.desc: Water-based sublimation printing on polyester performance fabrics for sportswear brands and gym wear manufacturers requiring vibrant, wash-fast colour output on stretch and technical textiles.

fabrics.title: Polyester Fabric Processors
fabrics.desc: Reliable sublimation output for polyester fabric processors producing performance, fashion, and home furnishing textiles.
